physical_class: For arbitrary traceless A∈M4 and B unitarily similar to −A, independent local unitary conjugation reduces to X=A⊗I−I⊗A. The global (not local) tensor-swap involution anticommutes with X, so H=X†X commutes with swap and a top right singular vector has a parity eigenvalue; its left partner has opposite parity. The consolidated theorem hence gives σ1²≤L=2||A||², and if A² is nonnormal its exact equality analysis gives σ1²<L and strict T2. This is not the local-chiral class in general.
symbolic_nonchiral_structural_example: Let s,t,u>0 pairwise distinct, λ=(s,t,u,−s−t−u), z1,z2,z3≠0, T=I+(z1e1+z2e2+z3e3)e4ᵀ and A=T diag(λ) T^(−1), B=−A. Eigenvectors e1,e2,e3 and e4+Σz_i e_i have a connected nonorthogonality graph, so every commuting orthogonal projection is trivial: both factors are unitarily irreducible. Eigenvalues λ_i² are distinct and the same eigenvectors are nonorthogonal, so A² and B² are nonnormal. The all-real non-sign-symmetric spectra preclude local chiral symmetry and irreducible single-cycle weighted permutations. No selected numeric/q parameter.
